title: Assassin's Creed: Brotherhood of Venice
subtitle: Tactical stealth, rooftop infiltration, and headquarters management in Renaissance Italy
tagline: We work in the dark to serve the light
loreSummary: Venice, 1509. In the shadows between the events of Brotherhood and Revelations, you lead a secret cell of Assassins navigating treacherous canals, unmasking Templar conspirators, and expanding your hidden brotherhood.
keyFeatures: Tactical stealth & detection mechanics with rooftop climbing and hidden assassination strikes
Sealed memory envelopes revealing new equipment, events, and story turns mission by mission
Headquarters management to heal wounded Assassins, craft renaissance gear, and fulfill contracts
Canonical story set in 1509 Venice featuring Ezio Auditore and Leonardo da Vinci

acbov_full_campaign.name: Full Venetian Campaign (26 Memories)
acbov_full_campaign.description: The complete narrative arc across Sequences 0 through 4, discovering all secret envelopes and taking back Renaissance Venice.

acbov_early_sequences.name: Early Operations (Sequences 0–2)
acbov_early_sequences.description: Prologue tutorial through Leonardo's rescue across 15 core memories, ideal for an introductory narrative experience.

acbov_master_sync.name: 100% Full Synchronization & Replays
acbov_master_sync.description: Complete campaign including optional secondary objectives, contract missions, and perfectionist synchronization runs.

milestones.title: The Forgotten Headquarters
milestones.description: Liberate an abandoned Venetian hideout to serve as the headquarters for your Assassin brotherhood.

milestones.title: The Venetian Masquerade
milestones.description: Infiltrate carnival celebrations and expose the corrupt network of Venetian magistrates.

milestones.title: The Endangered Genius
milestones.description: Protect Leonardo da Vinci and recover secret blueprints before Templar agents seize them.

milestones.title: The Web of Treachery
milestones.description: Survive sudden betrayals and penetrate the inner fortified sanctuaries of the Venetian elite.

milestones.title: Liberation of Venice
milestones.description: Strike down the Grand Master and secure the freedom of Renaissance Venice once and for all.
